column1: # ESP32 OTA updater — STANDALONE-BUILD PLACEHOLDER ONLY.
# This table is intentionally NOT matched to the freeesp32_ave device table.
# The updater is project-independent and resolves all partitions at RUNTIME from
# whatever table is flashed on the device (esp_ota_*/esp_partition_*); its own
# compiled-in table is never written when only its app image is flashed to ota_1.
# Sizes below exist solely so a standalone `idf.py build` succeeds — do not edit.
